base_member_text: [L1002-L1004,L240-L242] (LOW/report-state) A run that executes no tests unconditionally appends a crash row, potentially duplicating a recovered-crash row or reporting a crash for an empty suite.
audit_member_text: [L1002-L1004,L1073-L1075] (MED/empty-suite-reporting) The footer marks the previous test as crashed whenever no test ran, including a legitimate empty suite, and can duplicate the crash marker already emitted during restart.

adversarial.rationale: has_run starts false and is set true only inside an actually executed test; the footer calls previous_failed solely on .not.has_run. That routine unconditionally emits Crashed, without checking whether a previous test exists or was already marked during restart at L240-L242.

base_member_text: [L174-L180] (MED/exit-status) Finalization executes a plain STOP regardless of failed assertions, leaving process-exit-based automation without a failure status.
audit_member_text: [L174-L180] (MED/process-exit-status) The runner terminates with bare STOP regardless of nofails, so process-exit-based CI can report success after failed assertions.

adversarial.rationale: runtests_final removes the restart file, writes results and executes bare STOP independent of nofails. The selected TeamCity hook can separately report failures, but its completion hook is empty, so it does not repair the claimed process-exit-only CI failure mode.

base_member_text: [L713-L715,L767-L768,L811-L812] (MED/comparison-truncation) File comparisons silently discard content after 200 characters per line or 20 characters per token, so differences beyond those limits can pass.
audit_member_text: [L713-L715,L767-L768,L801-L802,L811-L812] (MED/comparison-truncation) Fixed-length line and token reads silently discard text beyond 200 characters per line or 20 characters per token, allowing differing files to compare equal.

adversarial.rationale: Silent truncation is real for records longer than 200 characters or tokens longer than 20 characters, but these storage limits are disclosed in the routine comments. Narrow to LOW out-of-contract input handling rather than a false comparison within the documented record/token bounds; there is still no runtime rejection of oversized input.

base_member_text: [L119,L138,L220-L242] (MED/restart-state) Successful tests persist the same previous=true marker as started tests, so a subsequent runtests call can label a completed test as crashed and skip tests using a reset local numbering sequence.

audit_member_text: [L155-L160,L220-L245,L109-L111,L137-L138] (HIGH/multi-suite-state) Every runtests call resets test numbering and reloads the previous suite's last_test, so the documented multiple-call workflow can skip tests in later suites and label completed work as crashed.

[L118-L119,L137-L138,L240-L241,L1073-L1079] (MED/restart-failure-accounting) Started and completed tests persist the same true marker, while crash recovery only updates failed_asserts and neither increments nofails nor emits a failure hook.

adversarial.rationale: runtests_init only disables automatic finalization, while each runtests invocation resets testno and reloads last_test from the file left by the preceding suite. A successful first suite ending at test 2 makes a second two-test suite skip both tests and emit a restart crash marker; the existing single-suite XBeach caller avoids the trigger but does not fix the explicitly documented multiple-call API.

base_member_text: [L443,L479,L532,L576,L612,L665,L824] (MED/nonfinite-comparison) Greater-than-only tolerance checks accept NaNs and can accept finite-versus-infinite values because neither nonfinite operands nor nonfinite thresholds are rejected.
audit_member_text: [L443,L479,L532,L576,L612,L665,L824] (HIGH/numeric-false-pass) Approximate comparisons only fail on a greater-than test, so NaNs and unequal infinities can pass without recording an assertion failure.

adversarial.rationale: All scalar and array comparison bodies lack finite-value checks, and shape guards do not reject NaN elements in equal-shaped arrays. With ordinary nontrapping IEEE arithmetic and a positive finite margin, NaN-versus-finite and infinity-versus-finite make the greater-than predicate false; neither callers nor build instructions impose a universal trap or finite-input precondition.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L443,L479,L532,L576,L612,L665] (MED/numerical-overflow) The sum of operand magnitudes can overflow before multiplication by the tolerance and falsely accept materially different large finite values.
audit_member_text: [L443,L576,L824] (MED/numeric-overflow) The relative-error threshold sums absolute magnitudes before scaling, allowing large finite inputs to overflow the threshold and pass despite substantial differences.

adversarial.rationale: The parenthesized sum of magnitudes is evaluated before the tolerance scaling; no max-based rescaling or saturation guard exists in the enclosing comparators. For double values 1.6e308 and 1.0e308 with margin 0.01, the difference is finite but the threshold becomes infinity under nontrapping IEEE arithmetic, so the comparison passes.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L808-L824] (MED/parser-contract) Ignored list-directed tokenization errors and a literal question-mark sentinel can hide malformed or missing tokens, while numeric conversion uses only default-real precision.
audit_member_text: [L808-L824] (MED/parser-contract) List-directed tokenization errors are ignored and missing tokens use the real text sentinel '?', so malformed or slash-terminated records and literal question-mark tokens can hide differences.
[L723-L724,L820-L824] (MED/comparison-precision) File numbers are parsed into default REAL, so differences below single-precision resolution disappear even when the requested tolerance is tighter.

adversarial.rationale: The complete tokenizer resets all slots to literal question marks and deliberately ignores both tokenization statuses before comparing slots. Equal prefixes followed by slash-terminated differing text, or an extra literal question-mark token versus a missing token, can therefore leave identical item arrays; numeric conversion checks occur only after unequal item strings and cannot repair this.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L1050,L1124,L1175-L1178,L1493-L1498] (MED/output-escaping) Test descriptions and compared strings are embedded directly in HTML without escaping markup characters.
audit_member_text: [L1050,L1124,L1175-L1178,L1493-L1498] (MED/output-escaping) Test descriptions, compared strings, and file contents are emitted as raw HTML, allowing ordinary angle brackets and ampersands to alter or conceal report content.

adversarial.rationale: The enclosing HTML writers interpolate description and compared-string arguments directly between markup fragments, and their callers pass original text. Neither trim nor the row-state helpers escape ampersands or angle brackets, so text containing HTML markup can alter the rendered report.
